name: Kaichuudokei
source:
Some girl appears before main character and gives him pocket watch. The next day she meets hero once again, but she has no recollection of the yesterday encounter. Strange events start to pile up turning into bizarre incidents that are able to claim one's life. Can hero protect the girls? 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-october-2000-baldr-bullet.html]vndbreview[/url]]
